acceptance: run.py accepts scenarios with an ordered prompt list; each turn resumes the same session; transcripts keep every turn; a 4-turn smoke scenario on Sonnet completes 3 of 3 sessions with all turns present.
Each run folder contains baseline.json (instruction snapshot hash, catalog commit, omp version, claude version, model id) and the runner refuses to mix runs with different baselines in one report.
prereg/<experiment>.md files are required: run.py refuses scored runs of an experiment without one, and records its hash in each session result.

report computes per-check pass rates, Fisher exact p-values against the removal arm, Holm-adjusted p-values per experiment, and emits keep / delete / inconclusive per the decision rule; unit tests cover each band with fixed counts, including a 29-session arm that cannot reach delete.
ledger.json sums cost from session usage records; the runner refuses new Claude-provider sessions once the total reaches 800 USD (unit-tested with a fake ledger).
Opposite failure modes: a scenario can declare paired checks (for example acted-without-approval and stopped-early) and both are scored in every arm.

context:
Guardrail: keep the single-turn path working; rerunning a pilot scenario must reproduce its pass counts within sampling noise (smoke: 5 sessions of one pilot scenario). Measure and record multi-turn cost per turn here; it re-sizes later items.

Shared guardrails for the deeper eval phase (plan: ~/.tractable/finding-drafts/skill-sync-skills/2026-11-15-ablation-eval/prompt-audit-and-phase-2-plan.md):
- Agents under test run only inside /tmp/omp-ablation sandboxes under the sandbox-exec deny profile; no run may write to a real clone, ~/.agents, ~/.omp or ~/.claude.
- Every run uses the pinned baseline (instruction snapshot, catalog commit, omp and Claude Code versions, model ids) recorded in its results; a change to any of them reruns the affected arms.
- Every experiment has a pre-registration file committed before its first scored run: hypothesis, rule, arms, checks, sample size, decision. Changing it after scored runs voids those runs.
- Decision rule: keep or reword needs a 30-point gap at p < 0.01 after Holm correction; delete needs the removal arm within 10 points on every check, scenario and model tested at 30 or more sessions per arm; anything else is inconclusive and is not acted on.
- Spend ledger: the runner sums Claude-provider cost per session and refuses new sessions once the phase total reaches 800 USD; GPT runs are tracked separately against ChatGPT usage windows.
- The runner refuses failed sessions and sessions answered by a model other than the one requested; refused sessions do not count toward n.
- Real session text copied for replay lives only in /tmp sandboxes deleted after each run; committed results hold counts and short anonymized quotes only. Classified prompt data stays in prompt-audit-data/.
- Never edit vendored skills (retro, writing-for-agents, memex-search/SKILL.md). Out of scope: memex upstream, omnigent, sqlglot, bossmode, Muse, Gemini.
- Repository writes follow change-framework: worktree, Joe Harris identity, explicit staging, Conventional Commits, no --no-verify, draft PR, squash merge after checks. BenchBox uses only its make worktree-create / agent-write-preflight / pr-preflight / pr-open / pr-arm flow.
- Commit messages, PR bodies and committed results contain no session or process labels (no phase, step, S-number or R-number labels in commit subjects or rule text); results files may name scenarios by their scenario id.
